rationale: The ui.js (bridge JS) emitter now gives a browser-captured one-line text run its captured width, as the native materializer already does, instead of leaving it to Pulp's own measurement. It is a sizing choice inside Pulp's own codegen for captured text: no DesignIR schema, Chromium capture, renderer backend, asset or packaging authority moves, and Figma one-line titles keep their existing behaviour.
